settled = re.findall(r'TX-\d+\s+account=\S+\s+region=EMEA\s+status=SETTLED\s+amount_cents=\d+', context)
count = len(settled)
total = 0
max_id = ''
max_amount = -1
for record in settled:
    tx_id = re.search(r'TX-\d+', record).group()
    amount = int(re.search(r'amount_cents=(\d+)', record).group(1))
    total += amount
    if amount > max_amount or (amount == max_amount and tx_id > max_id):
        max_id = tx_id
        max_amount = amount
print(count, total, max_id, max_amount)
